repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period with a threshold of 30, causing the action to fire after 30 seconds (30,000 ms). The IR requires the condition to be sustained for 30 seconds (30,000 ms) starting from t=0. With a 1000 ms period, the first tick counts at t=0, so the action must wait until the 301st tick (at 30,000 ms) to match the 30-second duration. The candidate fires at the 30th tick (29,000 ms) because it uses `hold >= 30` instead of `hold >= 301`.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the threshold from 30 to 301 to account for the initial tick at t=0 when the condition is already true. This ensures the action fires exactly at 30,000 ms, matching the IR's 30-second sustain requirement.
